#!/bin/sh
# This program is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it
# under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free
# Software Foundation; either version 2 of the License, or any later version.
set -eu
export LC_ALL=C
root=$(pwd -P)
case "$root" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_./-]*) exit 90;; esac
mkdir builddir-bsd
b="$root/builddir-bsd/lib06"
mkdir "$b" "$b/captures"
# Stream complete or partial evidence on this already authenticated session.
# Preserve the original native failure even if archive creation also fails.
collect_evidence() {
    capture_exit=$1
    trap - 0
    if tar czf - builddir-bsd; then :
    else
        archive_exit=$?
        if test "$capture_exit" -eq 0; then capture_exit=$archive_exit; fi
    fi
    exit "$capture_exit"
}
trap 'collect_evidence "$?"' 0
sha() {
    if command -v sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256 -q "$1"
    elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        sha256sum "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
    else shasum -a 256 "$1" | awk '{print $1}'; fi
}
verify_sources() {
    while read -r expected name; do
        test -f "$name" && test ! -L "$name"
        actual=$(sha "$name")
        test "$actual" = "$expected"
    done < source.sha256
}
verify_sources
cp source.sha256 "$b/source-before.sha256"
uname -s > "$b/os.txt"
uname -r > "$b/release.txt"
uname -m > "$b/architecture.txt"
ccbin=$(command -v cc)
"$ccbin" --version > "$b/compiler.txt" 2>&1
sha "$ccbin" > "$b/compiler.sha256"
flags="-std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_BSD_SOURCE -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I$root/include -I$root"
if test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin; then flags="$flags -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE"; fi
printf '%s\n' "$flags" > "$b/compiler-flags.txt"
compile() {
    compile_label=$1; shift
    printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$b/compile-$compile_label.args"
    if /usr/bin/time -p "$@" > "$b/compile-$compile_label.stdout" \
        2> "$b/compile-$compile_label.stderr"; then compile_exit=0
    else compile_exit=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$compile_exit" > "$b/compile-$compile_label.exit"
    test "$compile_exit" -eq 0
}
compile baseline-probe "$ccbin" $flags -c tests/status_serializer_probe.c \
    -o "$b/baseline-probe.o"
compile cjson "$ccbin" $flags -c libs/cJSON.c -o "$b/cjson.o"
compile candidate-probe "$ccbin" $flags -DSERIALIZER_YYJSON \
    -I"$root/yyjson" -c tests/status_serializer_probe.c -o "$b/candidate-probe.o"
compile yyjson "$ccbin" $flags -c yyjson/yyjson.c -o "$b/yyjson.o"
compile baseline "$ccbin" "$b/baseline-probe.o" "$b/cjson.o" \
    -lm -o "$b/baseline"
compile candidate "$ccbin" "$b/candidate-probe.o" "$b/yyjson.o" \
    -lm -o "$b/candidate"
compile native-timeout "$ccbin" $flags native_timeout.c -o "$b/native-timeout"
for program in baseline candidate native-timeout; do
    sha "$b/$program" > "$b/$program-before.sha256"
    wc -c < "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.bytes"
    file "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.file"
    size "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.size" 2>&1
    if ldd "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.dependencies" 2>&1; then
        dependency_exit=0
    else dependency_exit=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$dependency_exit" > "$b/$program.dependencies.exit"
done
count=0
run_probe() {
    run_backend=$1; shift
    count=$((count + 1))
    test "$count" -le 2048
    last="$b/captures/run-$count"
    printf '%s\n' "$run_backend" > "$last.backend"
    printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$last.args"
    if "$b/native-timeout" 30 "$last.metrics" "$b/$run_backend" "$@" \
        > "$last.stdout" 2> "$last.stderr"; then code=0; else code=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$last.exit"
    # Timeout, cancellation, unconfirmed wait or setup failure aborts this job;
    # qemu_bsd then collects failure evidence and stops only its owned VM.
    case "$code" in 0|2|3) :;; *) exit "$code";; esac
}
for mode in baseline candidate candidate-borrowed; do
    backend=$mode; mode_options=
    if test "$mode" = candidate-borrowed; then
        backend=candidate; mode_options=--borrowed
    fi
    for case_name in ordinary unicode legacy legacy-keys numbers large stress \
        queue-below queue-at status-below status-at; do
        run_probe "$backend" emit "$case_name" $mode_options
        run_probe "$backend" measure "$case_name" $mode_options
        stats="$last.stdout"
        case "$case_name" in
            large|stress)
                run_probe "$backend" emit "$case_name" $mode_options \
                    --mutate-input;;
        esac
        case "$case_name" in
            ordinary|legacy|legacy-keys|numbers)
                total=$(sed -n 's/.*"attempts_last":\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' "$stats")
                case "$total" in ''|*[!0-9]*|????*) exit 91;; esac
                test "$total" -gt 0 && test "$total" -le 512
                ordinal=0
                while test "$ordinal" -lt "$total"; do
                    run_probe "$backend" measure "$case_name" $mode_options \
                        --fail-at "$ordinal"
                    run_probe "$backend" emit "$case_name" $mode_options \
                        --fail-at "$ordinal"
                    ordinal=$((ordinal + 1))
                done;;
        esac
        for budget in 1 64; do
            run_probe "$backend" measure "$case_name" $mode_options \
                --budget "$budget"
        done
    done
done
for case_name in ordinary large stress; do
    for repetition in 1 2 3; do
        order='baseline candidate candidate-borrowed'
        if test "$repetition" = 2; then
            order='candidate-borrowed candidate baseline'
        fi
        for mode in $order; do
            backend=$mode; mode_options=
            if test "$mode" = candidate-borrowed; then
                backend=candidate; mode_options=--borrowed
            fi
            run_probe "$backend" measure "$case_name" $mode_options \
                --native --repeat 1000
        done
    done
done
verify_sources
cp source.sha256 "$b/source-after.sha256"
for program in baseline candidate native-timeout; do
    sha "$b/$program" > "$b/$program-after.sha256"
    cmp "$b/$program-before.sha256" "$b/$program-after.sha256"
done
printf '%s\n' "$count" > "$b/capture-count.txt"
printf '%s\n' 'native observations captured; host oracle still required' \
    > "$b/capture-complete.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# This program is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it
# under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free
# Software Foundation; either version 2 of the License, or any later version.
"""Actual isolated MFL output; no X server, WM, managed actions or user data."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import select
import signal
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

p = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
p.add_argument('--module', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--baseline', type=Path, required=True)
p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
a.output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
assert struct.calcsize('@L') == 8
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
r = {'module_sha256': sha(a.module), 'baseline_sha256': sha(a.baseline),
     'abi': {'unsigned_long_bytes': 8, 'header_words': 4,
             'start_flag': 0xffffffff, 'event': 1 << 10},
     'cases': {}, 'real_core_or_x': False}
up_read, up_write = os.pipe()
down_read, down_write = os.pipe()
os.set_blocking(up_read, False)
commands, command_bytes = [], bytearray()
pending = bytearray()
child = None
connection = None
overall = time.monotonic() + 30


def save():
    (a.output / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')


def drain():
    while True:
        try:
            data = os.read(up_read, 4096)
        except BlockingIOError:
            break
        assert data, 'module closed its command pipe'
        command_bytes.extend(data)
        assert len(command_bytes) <= 65536
    while len(command_bytes) >= 16:
        window, length = struct.unpack('@2L', command_bytes[:16])
        assert length <= 1000
        total = 24 + length
        if len(command_bytes) < total:
            break
        continuation, = struct.unpack('@L', command_bytes[16 + length:total])
        assert window == 0 and continuation == 1
        commands.append(bytes(command_bytes[16:16 + length]))
        assert len(commands) <= 1024
        del command_bytes[:total]


def record():
    assert time.monotonic() < overall
    deadline = min(overall, time.monotonic() + 5)
    while b'\n' not in pending:
        assert child.poll() is None
        left = deadline - time.monotonic()
        assert left > 0, 'MFL record deadline'
        ready, _, _ = select.select([connection, up_read], [], [], left)
        if up_read in ready:
            drain()
        if connection in ready:
            data = connection.recv(65536)
            assert data
            pending.extend(data)
            assert len(pending) <= 256 * 1024
    line, _, rest = pending.partition(b'\n')
    pending[:] = rest
    json.loads(line.decode('utf-8', errors='strict'))
    return bytes(line)


def packet(payload, terminated=True):
    body = struct.pack('@3L', 0x1234, 0, 0) + payload
    if terminated:
        body += b'\0'
    body += b'\0' * (-len(body) % 8)
    words = 4 + len(body) // 8
    assert words <= 256
    raw = struct.pack('@4L', 0xffffffff, 1 << 10, words, 1) + body
    assert len(raw) <= 2048
    assert os.write(down_write, raw) == len(raw)


def expected(payload):
    text = payload.decode('utf-8')
    return json.dumps({'window_name': {'window': '0x1234', 'name': text}},
                      ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode()


def cancel(signum, frame):
    raise SystemExit(128 + signum)


signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, cancel)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, cancel)
signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, cancel)


try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mfl6-', dir='/tmp') as name:
        directory = Path(name)
        env = os.environ | {'DISPLAY': 'lib06', 'FVWM_USERDIR': name,
                            'FVWMMFL_SOCKET_PATH': name}
        with (a.output / 'module.stdout').open('xb') as so, (
                a.output / 'module.stderr').open('xb') as se:

mkdir builddir-bsd
b="$root/builddir-bsd/lib06"
mkdir "$b" "$b/captures"
# Stream complete or partial evidence on this already authenticated session.
# Preserve the original native failure even if archive creation also fails.
collect_evidence() {
    capture_exit=$1
    trap - 0
    if tar czf - builddir-bsd; then :
    else
        archive_exit=$?
        if test "$capture_exit" -eq 0; then capture_exit=$archive_exit; fi
    fi
    exit "$capture_exit"
}
trap 'collect_evidence "$?"' 0
sha() {
    if command -v sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256 -q "$1"
    elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        sha256sum "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
    else shasum -a 256 "$1" | awk '{print $1}'; fi
}
verify_sources() {
    while read -r expected name; do
        test -f "$name" && test ! -L "$name"
        actual=$(sha "$name")
        test "$actual" = "$expected"
    done < source.sha256
}
verify_sources
cp source.sha256 "$b/source-before.sha256"
uname -s > "$b/os.txt"
uname -r > "$b/release.txt"
uname -m > "$b/architecture.txt"
ccbin=$(command -v cc)
"$ccbin" --version > "$b/compiler.txt" 2>&1
sha "$ccbin" > "$b/compiler.sha256"
flags="-std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_BSD_SOURCE -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I$root/include -I$root"
if test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin; then flags="$flags -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE"; fi
printf '%s\n' "$flags" > "$b/compiler-flags.txt"
compile() {
    compile_label=$1; shift
    printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$b/compile-$compile_label.args"
    if test -x /usr/bin/time; then
        set -- /usr/bin/time -p "$@"
        printf '%s\n' available > "$b/compile-$compile_label.timing"
    else
        printf '%s\n' unavailable > "$b/compile-$compile_label.timing"
    fi
    if "$@" > "$b/compile-$compile_label.stdout" \
        2> "$b/compile-$compile_label.stderr"; then compile_exit=0
    else compile_exit=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$compile_exit" > "$b/compile-$compile_label.exit"
    test "$compile_exit" -eq 0
}
compile baseline-probe "$ccbin" $flags -c tests/status_serializer_probe.c \
    -o "$b/baseline-probe.o"
compile cjson "$ccbin" $flags -c libs/cJSON.c -o "$b/cjson.o"
compile candidate-probe "$ccbin" $flags -DSERIALIZER_YYJSON \
    -I"$root/yyjson" -c tests/status_serializer_probe.c -o "$b/candidate-probe.o"
compile yyjson "$ccbin" $flags -c yyjson/yyjson.c -o "$b/yyjson.o"
compile baseline "$ccbin" "$b/baseline-probe.o" "$b/cjson.o" \
    -lm -o "$b/baseline"
compile candidate "$ccbin" "$b/candidate-probe.o" "$b/yyjson.o" \
    -lm -o "$b/candidate"
compile native-timeout "$ccbin" $flags native_timeout.c -o "$b/native-timeout"
for program in baseline candidate native-timeout; do
    sha "$b/$program" > "$b/$program-before.sha256"
    wc -c < "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.bytes"
    if file "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.file" 2>&1; then
        file_exit=0
    else file_exit=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$file_exit" > "$b/$program.file.exit"
    if size "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.size" 2>&1; then
        size_exit=0
    else size_exit=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$size_exit" > "$b/$program.size.exit"
    if ldd "$b/$program" > "$b/$program.dependencies" 2>&1; then
        dependency_exit=0
    else dependency_exit=$?; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$dependency_exit" > "$b/$program.dependencies.exit"
done
count=0
run_probe() {
    run_backend=$1; shift
    count=$((count + 1))
    test "$count" -le 2048
    last="$b/captures/run-$count"
    printf '%s\n' "$run_backend" > "$last.backend"
    printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$last.args"
    if "$b/native-timeout" 30 "$last.metrics" "$b/$run_backend" "$@" \
        > "$last.stdout" 2> "$last.stderr"; then code=0; else code=$?; fi

    # qemu_bsd then collects failure evidence and stops only its owned VM.
    case "$code" in 0|2|3) :;; *) exit "$code";; esac
}

    backend=$mode; mode_options=
    if test "$mode" = candidate-borrowed; then
        backend=candidate; mode_options=--borrowed
    fi
    for case_name in ordinary unicode legacy legacy-keys numbers large stress \
        queue-below queue-at status-below status-at; do

        run_probe "$backend" measure "$case_name" $mode_options

        case "$case_name" in
            large|stress)

                    --mutate-input;;
